question: On a circular path of 2742 m, Riya and Trisha start walking from the same point but in opposite directions at the speed of 4.6 m/s and X m/s, respectively. They will meet for the first time after 457 seconds. Find the value of X.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 2742 m, Time = 457 seconds.

Relative speed = Distance ÷ Time = 2742 ÷ 457 = 6 m/s.

In opposite directions, Relative speed = Speed₁ + Speed₂.

6 = 4.6 + X ⇒ X = 6 − 4.6 = 1.4 m/s.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.4 m/s.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/866ea48e29784c60a720b71d3f7ecc80df5d65496a51a0099f7810e184c8404e.png] 

**Given:**

Length of circular path (D) = 2742 m

Speed of **Riya** (S₁) = 4.6 m/s

Speed of **Trisha** (S₂) = X m/s

Time taken to meet (T) = 457 s

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (opposite direction) = S₁ + S₂

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ 457 = 2742 ÷ (4.6 + X)

⇒ 4.6 + X = 2742 ÷ 457

⇒ 4.6 + X = 6

⇒ X = 6 − 4.6

⇒ X = 1.4 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 1.4 m/s.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Circular Motion

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂). If they move in the same direction, it is the difference |S₁ − S₂|.

First Meeting on a Circular Track

The time taken for the first meeting is given by T = L ÷ (S₁ ± S₂), where L is the length of the track.

Meeting at the Starting Point

The time taken to meet at the starting point for the first time is the LCM of the times taken by each person to complete one full lap: LCM(L/S₁, L/S₂).</p
